promises.evidence: One canonical Gradle request/planner path is used by JVM/Android build/test/validation, typed workflow/TLJ/TestSpec lowering, artifact Gradle validation, project-runner instrumentation, and dedicated android instrumentation CLI prebuild; roadmap/federation consume the resulting canonical specs.
LauncherIdentity binds executable/source/version plus executable realpath+digest and wrapper distribution/properties/JAR/SHA identities.

ExecutionContext binds launcher, JDK executable+digest, substrate, project root, Gradle user home/cache domain, semantic environment digest, trusted context inputs, and bounded fail-closed build-logic identity.
ExecutionPolicy records requested/effective/provenance/reason for CC, build cache, daemon, VFS, parallelism, workers, heap, telemetry and failure policy, plus evidence-driven resource profile.

Planner owns root coalescing, aggregate substitution and typed semantic barriers; legacy split_gradle is represented as explicit-isolation intent rather than an implicit phase-name rule. ENV-G2 reconciliation additionally fixes and proves that coalescing preserves original semantic root order across typed barriers.

Protected context/JVM/init-script arguments fail closed; managed/raw and property-form switches converge once; real argv values affect opaque identity while serialized property evidence remains redacted.

Aggregate aliases require a self-consistent process-executed receipt and qualification binding exact roots/replacement/context/build-logic/request identities; booleans/hashes alone cannot self-authorize.
Aggregate/CC qualification changes with launcher/JDK/context/build-logic/root identity, and bounded build-logic overflow is explicitly incomplete and fails closed rather than silently truncating.
Heap policy separates default, phase recommendation, explicit request, host-safe ceiling, effective value and reason; host/resource profile evidence is retained.

ConfigurationCacheQualification records requested/effective, context/launcher/JDK/build-logic/argument/telemetry adapter identity and fallback; required mode fails closed. ENV-G2 owns real miss/store/hit proof.

Standard structured telemetry uses a bounded public BuildEvents shared-service adapter compatible by construction with CC; full detail uses a bounded legacy adapter and disables CC. Producer artifact scans are declared-producer scoped; receipts retain artifact/report refs. ENV-G2 owns real large-build proof.

Daemon/VFS/cache/parallel/workers are one canonical requested/effective policy derived from capabilities and host evidence rather than a phone-vs-desktop hardcode; OCI/local adapter identities are exact. ENV-G2 owns real host proof.
Balanced/constrained/emergency profiles are evidence-driven canonical policy states with provenance/reason/evidence; historical adaptive promotion/demotion remains ENV-X04.

Clean/effect/device and explicit caller isolation are typed barriers; validation phase labels alone do not create process barriers. ENV-G2 reconciliation additionally fixes and proves that coalescing preserves original semantic root order across typed barriers.

GradleExecutionReceipt binds requested/optimized/observed tasks/outcomes, selection, launcher/JDK/substrate, resource-profile evidence, reuse-layer policy, producer artifacts, reports, diagnostics and process/EXO/RER/RUN refs.
run_specs projects receipt identity/payload through existing TaskFinished execution metadata; ENV adds no scheduler/reuse/history truth store.

gate_reconciliation.finding: typed barriers were isolated but non-barrier roots could be moved ahead of earlier barriers
gate_reconciliation.disposition: folded into ENV-G2; contiguous normal regions coalesce without semantic reordering
